name: arkvolt
description: ARKVOLT — software storefront, hardware repair booking and operations platform.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @arkvolt/api" "npm run dev -w @arkvolt/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @arkvolt/shared && npm run build -w @arkvolt/api && npm run build -w @arkvolt/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @arkvolt/shared && npm run typecheck -w @arkvolt/api && npm run typecheck -w @arkvolt/web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
